shellCommands.command: git diff package.json && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -50 && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/

for f in next.config.ts tsconfig.json lib/products.ts app/*.tsx app/globals.css "app/product/[slug]/page.tsx"; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; ls __agent_eval__; grep -ril "viewtransition\|view-transition\|ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/docs/

cd /workspace; node -p "require('next/package.json').version+' react '+require('react/package.json').version"; grep -n -i -B2 -A15 "viewtransition" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md | head -60; grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rln "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js; grep -n "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js | head

cd /workspace; grep -o "exports\.[A-Za-z_]*ViewTransition[A-Za-z_]*\|exports\.[a-z_]*addTransitionType" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.production.js | sort -u; grep -n "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | grep -i "export const\|function ViewTransition\|const ViewTransition"; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -30

cd /workspace; python3 - <<'EOF' p='app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' s=open(p).read() s=s.replace("import { Suspense } from 'react'","import { Suspense, ViewTransition } from 'react'") s=s.replace("import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'\n","import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'\nimport { DirectionalTransition } from '../../DirectionalTransition'\n") old=s[s.index(" return (\n
\n
← Back to products
} >
) } ''' s=s.replace(old,new) open(p,'w').write(s) EOF git diff "app/product/[slug]/page.tsx"
which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npm ls playwright puppeteer 2>/dev/null | head
mkdir -p /tmp/pw && cd /tmp/pw && npm init -y >/dev/null && npm i playwright@1 >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium 2>&1 | tail -3
cd /tmp/pw && npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -3; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright
which dnf yum microdnf; cat /etc/os-release | head -3; sudo -n true 2>&1 && echo SUDO_OK

sudo dnf install -y -q nspr nss atk at-spi2-atk cups-libs libdrm libxkbcommon libXcomposite libXdamage libXfixes libXrandr mesa-libgbm pango alsa-lib libXext libX11 libxcb 2>&1 | tail -3; cd /tmp/pw && node test.mjs
cd /tmp/pw && node test.mjs reduce | grep -o '"::[^"]*"' | sort | uniq -c
cd /workspace; pkill -f "next start -p 3123"; rm -rf /tmp/pw; git status --short; git diff tsconfig.json
cd /workspace; git status --short; git diff tsconfig.json; pgrep -f "next start" || echo stopped
cd /workspace; git checkout tsconfig.json; rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; ps aux | grep -c "[n]ext-server\|[n]ext start"; git status --short
